title: 🏥 Saint Albans City VT: Multiple High-Paying Travel RN Roles
text:
7 hours ago Saint Albans City hospitals are pulling in extra help, and travel nurses are in demand this season. If you’re an experienced RN looking for good weekly pay and solid benefits, these TotalMed contracts are worth a look.
Travel Nurse RN – ICU (Intensive Care Unit) – ~$2,161/week Employer: TotalMed RN Location: Saint Albans, VT Salary: About $2,161 per week (36 hrs/week, nights) Type: Travel , 13-week contract, internship listed, 12-hour night shifts ICU role caring for high-acuity patients in life‑threatening situations. Ideal if you have 3+ years recent acute care ICU experience and ACLS, BLS, NIH ; comes with weekly pay, guaranteed hours, day‑1 medical/dental/vision, 401k, CE, wellness programs, and more.
Travel Nurse RN – ED (Emergency Department) – ~$2,161/week Employer: TotalMed RN Location: Saint Albans, VT Salary: About $2,161 per week (36 hrs/week, nights) Type: Travel , 13-week contract, internship listed, 12-hour night shifts Busy ER setting with triage, minor procedures, IV therapy, and fast-paced team care. Best fit for RNs with 3+ years ED experience plus ACLS, BLS, NIH, PALS ; includes weekly pay, guaranteed hours, day‑1 benefits, 401k, CE, wellness programs, and referral bonuses.
